description: This file defines an abstract base class 'EndpointIntegrationTestCase' for integration testing of API endpoints within the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for fixture data setup, test case retrieval, API mock creation, validation, and service registration, facilitating structured and reusable test setups for endpoint testing.

classes.name: EndpointIntegrationTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class designed for integration testing API endpoints in the OrangeHRM project, providing utility methods for fixture management, mock creation, validation, and service registration.

methods.name: populateFixtures
methods.description: Populates the test database with fixture data from specified files, optionally resetting cache.

methods.name: getTestCases
methods.description: Loads test case data from fixtures, returning an array of 'TestCaseParams' objects indexed by test case name.

methods.name: getApiEndpointMock
methods.description: Creates a mock of the specified API endpoint class configured with parameters from 'TestCaseParams'.

methods.name: assertValidTestCase
methods.description: Validates that an API endpoint behaves according to a given test case, including parameter validation, exception handling, and response verification.

methods.name: assertServicesInitialized
methods.description: Ensures expected services and factories are initialized as specified in the test case parameters.

methods.name: registerServices
methods.description: Registers services and factories into the test container based on 'TestCaseParams'.

methods.name: getMockAuthUser
methods.description: Creates a mock authenticated user object with properties based on the test case parameters.

methods.name: registerMockDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Mocks the DateTimeHelperService to return a fixed date/time from test parameters.
